title: Native acyclic-test K-flatness implies two-sided quasi-isomorphism preservation
statement: For the canonical native tensor of a finite-type quasi-compact separated scheme, with its additive and totalization instances, a cochain complex that tensors every acyclic complex to an acyclic complex satisfies both quasi-isomorphism preservation tests of NativeIsKFlat.

source.place: lemma-K-flat-quasi-isomorphism; total tensor symmetry and the mapping-cone criterion

proof.text: Transport the tensor of an acyclic complex through the native-to-ringed exact faithful equivalence and its total-complex comparison. Exchange the ringed tensor factors, and reflect acyclicity back. This gives the acyclic test in the opposite variable.

Tensor the mapping cone of a quasi-isomorphism in each variable. The tensor/cone isomorphisms and the acyclic mapping-cone criterion yield the two tests. The flip comparison converts right-first curried tensor to left-first native total tensor.

lean.statement:
theorem native_tensor_acyclic_test_kflat (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [(nativeTensorBifunctor k₀ l X).Additive]
    [∀ M, ((nativeTensorBifunctor k₀ l X).obj M).Additive]
    [∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ,
      P.HasMapBifunctor Q (nativeTensorBifunctor k₀ l X)]
    (P : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ)
    (hP : NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X (nativeTensorBifunctor k₀ l X) P) :
    NativeIsKFlat k₀ l X P
